After spending several hours in Planet Zoo, I can confidently say it’s a fantastic mix of creativity and deep management. Designing habitats and caring for the animals is a lot of fun, but the real challenge lies in balancing finances, staff, and guest satisfaction. Every decision, from animal welfare to marketing, feels important, and there’s a real sense of accomplishment when everything comes together. Watching your zoo grow and thrive is incredibly rewarding, making it a must-play for anyone who loves well-rounded, detailed management sims.

Changed to positive review... Its pretty fun and looks great. leaps ahead of the old and new zoo tycoons games. Its just EA sims level of DLCs which only add a handful of animals but I got the majority of them on sale in a big bundle, Animals have alot of animations the only Issues I really have is that it seems literally impossible to improve education levels, I will put education everywhere around my park and enclosures and hire educators but it stays at 1 star.. i dont get it.

My other main issue is WHERE ARE MARINE ANIMALS YOU GIVE US SO MANY DLCS AND WE HAVE EVERYTHING TO BUILD FOR SEMI AQUATIC SPECIES BUT WHY HAVE YOU NOT GIVEN US A FULL FLEDGED MARINE DLC THAT ADDS WHALES/ORCAS, DOLPHINES, SHARKS AND OTHER BIGGER FISH?? Old zoo Tycoon literally let you build aquariums and even had whale sharks. Theres plenty of aquariums that arent Seaworld so please dont tell me youre scared of backlash, just make them require tons of water space to be happy. seriously dont tell me youre waiting on Planet Zoo 2 like you guys did with Jurassic park...

I love the ability to design your zoo how you want it and it takes into account the RL mechanics of the animals, their needs, lifestyle, and everything. The options of customization are incredible. I grew up playing Zoo Tycoon 1 and 2 with all the expansion packs, and this is everything you could ever want in a zoo simulation game! It really brings home my favorite childhood game in all the ways Zoo Tycoon almost achieved.

I got this game for 5 around dollars from the winter sale, and boy am I glad. I would not pay full price for it. Before even playing it I bought a few DLCs, I was so sure I would love this game and they were cheap so I couldn't help myself. with the knowledge I have bought access to extra animals I am so disappointing in how many options there are, I expected way more. also I find most of the mechanics of the game to be needlessly complicated. I currently have 44 hours on the game and I still feel like I can't utilize a few of the building tools adequately. Also there are a few bugs that I feel should have been easy to catch and solve, mainly animals being "loose" while contently in their habitats.
-33 hours later, still playing this game but having no fun. I have no idea why I'm still playing, I hate it. I even bought another DLC this time keeping an eye out to see exactly how many animals came with it. I spent 9.99 for 4 animals. I give this game a 3/10.
I don't know if this is just a me thing, but trying to build the fences was so aggravating that I gave up and haven't been able to pick it up again

A little reminder to NOT support Zoos in reallife. Everything about them is bad and they're not helping the population or conservation of wildlife. The animals are just there for our entertainment and are in a lot of psychological pain.

This game tho is really fun and I am happy I can play it without real animals being caged and me supporting a zoo in reallife by visiting it. If you liked Planet Coaster you will enjoy this too, it's a really good game.

very tough, quite fun tho.

edit 1-more hours in, with hard work, it got easier

edit 2-after more hours, I would totally reccomend doing the franchise mode, building up an empire is delightful
I love this game. It's constantly coming out with new features but doesn't seem empty without them if you cant afford it. Wonderful game and great dev team.

Still no Work on bugs which exist since day one...

Planet Zoo is a wonderfull game and you will have great times while buildung up areals for your animals (that are looking and acting adorable). But there is a problem which exists since the day I started to play. The Zookeepers and sometimes the vets stop doing their job. It's annoying and frustrating to build a nice habitat for your animals and raise them up just to see them suffering and dying only because the zookeepers aren't able to walk across an areal with no obstacle (even the map shows none). Sometimes they stop doing their tasks for no reason even when their only task is to bring food to only one enclosure in the zoo.
It would be nice to see these problems fixed in the future.
Dlcs by the way are great but they would be even better if one update would solve the problem with the zookeepers...
i love this game i wish it had more tutorials so i could learn how to build cool zoos. they update regularly and i enjoy playing this game.

I really really really really wanted to love this game. I'd loved the original Zoo Tycoon franchise as a kid, and this seemed like a prettier, modern version of it. It's not, though. The game feels like it's entirely for building, and not tycoon management. For those who don't like the architectural aspect of it, the whole game feels like a chore. You can't get anything done without spending several hours trying to figure out how to put one building down in an area where your staff can access it. If the building aspect of the game were more similar to The Sims -- where you can make it as easy or complex as you want, depending on your playing style -- I guarantee this game would be much much much much more popular.
Not being able to easily place paths is just ridiculous. It's incredibly difficult to make a square walking area with any kind of exhibit, much like the scenario missions have.
Incredibly fun and detailed building construction simulator. The animals are great, but I spend 95% of my time detailing latrines.

Took a while to understand the controls (playing on Steam Deck) and had to change them via a Reddit post, but once everything was sorted it was great! Really love playing this and the graphics are amazing; I love the range of enrichment items you can get for different species, and designing the enclosures is really fun :) Would definitely recommend this game!
AMAZING GAME! I really enjoy building amazing Zoos. The DLCs are way too cheap for their quality; this game is truly inspiring

Love this Game! Hours just fly by as you tend to your animals and try to get them the best habitat possible, while trying to contain their offspring not overflowing everything.. tortoises are really horny it seems..

well so far i am really loving this game its very relaxing and calming, it can however be a lot to get your head around at first if you go straight into challenge mode, but the story mode will break you in a little slower. highly recommend picking this game up

This game as well as other planet games constantly crashes. I have tried every fix known both on the frontier website, and by other various articles, and still no joy. Most users have had issues since a potential March update.

When the game is running, (for the short time it is able to) the game is marvellous. One of the best management games available. This paired with the amount of community created content available, makes the game so fun to play.

If only It worked!

Fantastic Game.

Constantly getting lost into a new project. The sense of responsibility you get for these animals keep you coming back time and time again to improve their lives while improving the overall look of your Zoo. After a few hours/days go by, you'll have urself a nice looking Zoo filled with happy animals. 10/10 for anyone with relaxation mindset

It took me so long to understand how to do things, but i have neurospicy brain. My money management was terrible, but eventually it got through to me how to manage the money thing and how to start the zoos the right way not to get beyond bankrupt instantly. Once i got what i was doing, I HAD A FREAKING BLAST!!! 300 hours in, i recommend to everyone to at least try the game to see how things work before you go too crazy with dlcs. Play the story, it takes you through mechanics, and if you're not thick skulled and stubborn like me, you'll learn much faster what to do. I looove watching the exhibits experience my enclosures. My red pandas are the best happiest roller coaster backdrops! Do try, do recommend it to your friends. It's a fun game!

It's less a Zoo Tycoon and more about snapping objects together in a Maya-like editor and sharing your props on the Workshop. While welcomed to personalize a park to the nanometer, I feel that it detracts from the focus of the core game. Fundamentally, this overly burdensome element will be appreciated by many, but viewed as superfluous and detract from the focus of building enclosures and a large park. Not sure if it's my autism, but this component leads me to spend hours on a simple gharial exhibit. This feature of course does not do much aside from giving primates structures to climb on.

Light recommend because nothing, sparing hours upon hours on the smallest detail, will ever be "right."
Awesome game. My kids love the sandbox with unlimited money. I prefer the challenge of limited money. The tutorial is great. Love the graphics and gameplay. Highly recommend if you're into sim games.

This isn't like your favorite Zoo Tycoon but it's definitely an upgraded reimagining of it. Graphics are awesome though controls take a bit to learn as they aren't straightforward and not everything is explained. Once you get the hang of it though, it is worth it.

Not a fun expierence playing this game. Doing tasks should be a lot easier than what it is. Certain activities are over-complicated. An example of this is the replacement/fixing of the barrier for the habitats. It was so frustrating that I didn't even complete the tutorial.

All in all the game is on the standards for modern games: graphics are fine, ambient music is nice and most gameplay mechanics are interesting.

Therefore you don't get that much content for the money you pay. Many animals, wich you think have to be in every zoo, are missing in the base game, like penguins, or exotic fishes. I'm sure that's a strategy from Frontier to get much money from you buying the DLCs. The first DLC has pretty less content, appeared one and a half month after release and costs 10 bugs, however it has ice bears. If it's running similar like Planet Coaster, the complete game will cost around 150€. So don't get fooled by getting said, this game costs just 45€.

The game is bugged, too. I'm not speaking about the zoo personal, that's mostly a misunderstood feature. I'm speaking rather about problems, like placing objects on the right place.

Some things weren't elaborated sober. For example animals in vivariums aren't moving(, ok, ok the leguan is sometimes shaking slowly his/ her head) and plants are just objects( they haven't any needs for their environment like warmth.

nice game to play and be creative, although right now there seems to be a lot of bug. but, it's okay cause I believe the developer gonna fix it. hopefully in the future the developer will add expansion animal, like aquatic, or any other kind of expansion. thank's.

It's a good game. Great graphics with a huge world to do whatever with, but trying to learn how to play this game is so incredibly hard even with the tutorials. The tutorials don't give enough information to fully understand the harder objectives, but give soooo much info about very easy things. It's hard to play. Really hard to play. I'm just glad I got this on discount.

This game is so much fun, I'm still figuring it all out but there is so much to do and every update just adds more cool stuff like color morphs that make the breeding more exciting. The graphics are SO pretty and I just want to live inside this game. It is worth every single penny I paid for it and the expansion packs. It's now my favorite game of this style.
the game is very fun only sad the zookeepers are not nude and the animals have no mating animations thats sad to i dont think there is anything wrong with it otherwise.

Genuinely a great game! I play this nearly everyday and would definitely recommend to animal lovers and enthusiasts. You can create your own zoo, add nearly any animal you can imagine at a zoo and more! You can care for you animals and design their enclosure however you want.

Again, would definitely recommend!👍

If you like sims and animals - this is amazing. It is more in depth than I realized at first and can quickly become overwhelming, but the tutorials are excellent and time can be paused at any given time for you to address any crisis.

If you like Building and Management games, this is the game for you. It allows you to build your Zoo however you like (unless, of course, the paths don't fit). Should it be the case that, like me, you lack the motivation to come up with your own hand-crafted designs you must not fear, for you will spend a lot of time on the workshop page which is filled to the brim with awesome creations to help out newcomers and expert zoo designers alike. The base game offers enough objects and animals to feel fleshed out and enjoyable, but if you like the game you will not want to miss out on things like the Aquatic Pack. And to all the Zoo Tycoon 1-2 players: This is just what you need to fill that ZT3-shaped hole in your heart.

Really fun game! It's only as time consuming as you let it be. Planet Zoo can provide hours of entertainment. The animals are so accurately detailed and there is a lot of freedom when it comes to design construction. This is one of my favorite games!

Love this game. Game play is smooth with lots of creative animals and environments. Love the building menu which allows with every update something else completely new and exciting, without paying for DLC. Animals act real and people, well they do the peopling. Must play, for almost everyone.

When i first saw this game it just looked like a new zoo tycoon game. But trust me its not. Lets start of with the pros
-plenty of animals excluding dlcs
-6 dlcs
-steam workshop if youre not good at building
-Campaign
-Its great if you want to build!
Now for the cons!
-Expensive if not on sale
-Can get boring
-Building style is not like Jurassic world evolution its kinda complicated
-You have to research most items excluding sandbox
-Dont get big animals at the start or youre done for!
In conclusion i think you should get the game when it is on sale like it is now plus all dlcs are only 10$!
If you like Zoo building it is the best. i played Zoo tycoons in my childhood and Enjoy this now. Good Game.

This game which is why I was scared to buy it..is a lot... The learning curve..is definitely here and dreadful.. I do not have a hang of everything yet but...learning how to run and BUILD your zoo is actually enjoyable and even if it wasn't this game brings everything to the table and goes beyond my imagination..THE LEARNING CURVE IS REAL BRO

I am not playing this game anymore because of the totally useless barrier/wall creation tools.

You can't snap to paths, and it doesn't show you the angles. Half of your time is wasted trying to figure out the angles without being able to see them, and creating a simple square habitat (which should be one of the default selections, by the way) is frustrating. It's interesting to see that the developers don't even care to fix this, despite many people complaining about it.

Graphics of this game are absolutely breathtaking, animals look awesome... but who cares, if to learn and properly learn the game you have to invest a heck of time, and even then you spend most of the time fighting with clunky controls, badly designed UI and ton of micromanagement stuff that might be fun for certain people, but essentially draw you away from the main topic of the game - animals.
If you expected a Zoo Tycoon 2 successor, that's not a game for you I'm afraid. I was extremely hyped for that game, I even pre ordered it, played 10 hours because of the learning curve since launch.

I love all the accurate displays of animal behaviors. The facts and the ability to learn about different animals make it fun, entertaining, and very educational. I find myself playing this game for at least 4 hours at a time. I highly recommend this game if you love animals and being able to customize every little detail.

My hubs grabbed the base game on sale for me, knowing that I like simulation games. I've been a Sims girl since 1st release....first game to ever top it or even come close. I'm hooked and obsessed. Overwhelmed, frustrated, but still determined! Neither gameplay nor building are intuitive, but the concept, graphics. and the creative outlet are all worth the icks (or ticks). Bought nearly all DLC, done with 75% of career...onto franchise! If you see me out there and its looking rough, know I'm trying! I have big dreams that I never knew I had! Fantastic game for those that love sim gaming like me! YT is my bff right now...thank you to fellow zookeepers sharing their tips/tricks!!
As a certified Planet Zoo player, Aardvark lover, Murderer of 7 baby tortoises, and Natural Selection haver, I think think this game is awesome!

I absolutely love the customization part of the game where you can basically design your zoo however you would like whether that is multiple themes or just one. I also like the wide variety of animals that there is to choose from for your zoo.
clunky mechanics and lots of bugs. wasted 3 hours on this just trying to figure out how to fix a bug in the second tutorial.

After 300 hours i can Conclude This game Is worth the money.
But it's building Mechanics are shifted to advanced players instead of the common player.
The Graphics are truly Nice and Realistic.
But when you start the game for the first time it is very hard to master, like the Building and the layouts of you're zoo. what i wish it had was BUILDING TUTORIALS.

A stunning zoo builder with a huge choice of animals and a great in-game economy. I love being able to buy animals with money or with conservation points, and the scenarios are great fun. For me, the only let down is the fact that I'm not a great builder, so I sometimes struggle to make the zoos look nice as some pieces are quite intricate.

It's a great game but a little confusing when you first are starting. Like when i got a staff room it said that it had no power and to get something for it but i didn't know what or where to get the thing for power.

This game is really good. You can be the manager of a zoo with tones of different animals to look after. Satisfying all their needs, educating your guests, conserving endangered species, all while trying to manage your finances. There are different modes that you can play too. There is Franchise mode where you can create a chain of different zoos all around the world. This allows you to trade your animals to other players. Another mode is Career mode that you can work through an complete. And not forgetting Sandbox where you can create your own zoo and not have to worry about the more complex things. Overall this is a very good game and I would recommend getting it.

I freaking love this game, I love animals, I love the building, it tickles my brain the right way and I can't get enough of it, I hope in the future they have a aquatic animals DLC planned, I'd love to make a giant aquarium area and an area to have dolphins or orcas that would be so cool, other than that I fully recommend this game!

Planet Zoo is such a beautiful, relaxing sandbox game with endless building possibilities, a great soundtrack, and absolutely stunning visuals! I've thoroughly enjoyed the time I've spent on this game so far, and would definitely recommend it!

tldr.text: Very Positive (91%): players praise the graphics and art.
The most common complaint is bugs and crashes.

details.text: Players with under 2 hours at review time are 44% positive, while those with over 50 hours are 96%.
Recent reviews mention bugs and crashes far less often, but gameplay complaints have risen, with one saying mechanics "feel weird and clunky".
